text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is coming to an end. We've become a truly formidable team as we relaxed over the summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nervously check in on Super Creek. I wonder how she feels now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I can't quite explain it… I feel like… a bone's been dislodged.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Like a fish bone that's been stuck in your throat for who knows how long.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And with the bone now gone, I feel amazing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think I'll be okay, but even if I'm not…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I have my loyal trainer here to support me! Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like everything's worked out. She might be in tip-top shape again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Shall we go back then, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, to our former selves when we debuted together—to when we didn't have a care in the world.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The Classics… They're still out there, waiting to be conquered, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. We still have time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As long as we can make the Kikuka Sho, I know that Super Creek can prove to everyone what she's truly made of.
